talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.tyrant: Stop. By the king's command, every stranger's pack is searched. Open it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.noble: Pardon the trouble, traveller. There's been thieving, and we're asked to look in strangers' packs. Would you mind?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.warlord: You. Pack open. The commander wants to know what strangers carry into his city.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.paranoid: Hold still. The king believes someone means him harm. Let's see what's in your pack.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reveler: Ho there! Spot check, friend. What've you got in the pack? Anything for the feast?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.plain: Mind if I look in your pack? There's been things going missing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.tyrant.more: Open it, or we open you. Those are the king's words, not mine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.noble.more: We'll be quick, and anything that's yours stays yours. It's only that goods have gone missing from the stores.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.warlord.more: Steel, powder, poison. A soldier knows what to look for. Show me and you can go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.paranoid.more: Knives, poison, letters to his enemies. You'd be amazed what we find. Open it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reveler.more: Honestly it's mostly to see if anyone's brought cake. Go on, let's have a look.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.plain.more: Just a look, then you're on your way. Folk have lost things lately.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.purist: You. %2$s. Your sort steals; everyone knows it. Open your pack.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.purist_kin: Ah, %3$s blood, like mine. A formality, brother. Just open the pack and we're done.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.purist.more: Anyone not of %3$s blood is searched coming in. The king's orders. Open it, or turn around.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.purist_kin.mo: We only bother our own when there's been thieving. One look, and you're on your way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.t: What's this? Stolen! %s for the king, and pray he doesn't hear of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.n: Ah. I believe this belongs to the stores. A fine of %s, and we'll say no more.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.w: Thief. %s to the garrison. Next time it's a cell.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.p: I knew it. Stolen goods. %s, and you're being watched from now on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.r: Oh dear, that's from the larder! %s for the feast and we'll forget it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.p: Stolen. Of course it is. Your sort can't help it. %s.
From one of our own, too. Shame on you. %s, and don't shame your blood again.
That's ours. %s, and don't do it again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.clean.t: Nothing. Pity. A coin for my trouble, then.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.clean.n: All in order. Thank you for your patience, and welcome.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.clean.p: Nothing... this time. Off you go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.clean.r: Not even a biscuit? Shame! Off you go, enjoy the feast.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.clean.p: As I thought. Good blood, clean hands. Go on, brother.
Nothing there. Sorry to bother you.
Refusing the king's men? Seize them!
As you wish. I can't make you. But I'll remember your face.
Hiding something, are we? I'll be watching you.
Only the guilty hide. Take them!
You don't refuse your betters. Out of my sight.
Fair enough. Your word's good enough for me, kinsman.
Suit yourself. But folk will talk.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.t: ...I see nothing here. Move along, quickly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.n: A bribe? You insult me, and you insult the king.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.w: Put that away before I cut your hand off. A soldier can't be bought.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.p: A bribe! Only someone with something to hide offers a bribe. Seize them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.r: Ha! That'll buy a round. I saw nothing!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.p: Your coin's as dirty as your blood. Keep it.
Between kin? Put it away... no, all right, I'll take it. Off you go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.tyrant.her: Stop. By the queen's command, every stranger's pack is searched. Open it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.paranoid.her: Hold still. The queen believes someone means her harm. Let's see what's in your pack.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.tyrant.more.h: Open it, or we open you. Those are the queen's words, not mine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.paranoid.more: Knives, poison, letters to her enemies. You'd be amazed what we find. Open it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.purist.more.h: Anyone not of %3$s blood is searched coming in. The queen's orders. Open it, or turn around.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.t: What's this? Stolen! %s for the queen, and pray she doesn't hear of it.
Refusing the queen's men? Seize them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.n: A bribe? You insult me, and you insult the queen.
